label: Comtrend GRG-4362 XGS-PON ONT
description: XGS-PON bridge/gateway with 1× 10GBase-T LAN and no Wi-Fi; ITU-T G.987 optical at 10 Gbit/s symmetric, TR-069 management, 12 Vdc/1 A adapter.
notes: Vendor specifications: 'XGS-PON x1' (PHY US 10Gbps, DS 10Gbps, Standard ITU-T G.987, US 1270 nm, DS 1577 nm) and '10Giga Ethernet x1' (10G/5G/2.5G/1G/100M/10M bps, IEEE 802.3an/bz/ab/u/i, Auto-MDIX). The 10GBase-T port auto-negotiates 5G/2.5G/1G, so a slower host on it is not a misconfiguration. 'Routing software function integrated', hence l3-forward. Package includes a 12 Vdc/1.0 A adapter. No Wi-Fi and no voice port. Connector polish is not published; sc-apc is the XGS-PON subscriber interface this catalogue models.
